global.tone: No-fluff newspaper briefs: fact first, concrete detail, no hype, no filler.

sections.label: Indian Markets & Economy
sections.prompt: Prioritize Nifty/Sensex movement, RBI policy, and SWP/mutual fund related news. Skip pure stock-tip articles.

sections.label: World
sections.prompt: Favor geopolitics and economic policy over local/domestic stories.

sections.label: Technology
sections.prompt: Prefer product launches, AI research and big platform moves over listicles and deals.

sections.label: Credit Cards & Rewards
sections.prompt: Indian credit card launches, reward-programme changes, and devaluations. Skip generic money-saving listicles.
